purpose: Classify the eleven consumed P011 cases where the sealed projected reference is Stage0 while the frozen P008 relocation guard is positive, without changing either the P011 ledger or P008 thresholds.

classification_semantics.R1_GUARD_OVERFIRE: The frozen numeric guard asserts relocation but full consumed T-only path evidence does not support coherent repricing.
classification_semantics.R2_REFERENCE_UNDERCALL: The path supports coherent relocation and the original blind atomic reviewer likely under-called relocation; independent instability is not needed to explain the shape.
classification_semantics.R3_GENUINE_COEXISTENCE: The path supports both coherent relocation and independent structural disorder; the projected Stage0 target collapsed a legitimate mixed atomic state.
classification_semantics.R4_UNRESOLVED: Consumed T-only evidence does not support a bounded semantic choice among R1-R3.

cases.reason: A material endpoint repricing coexists with large expansion, giveback and repeated two-sided movement; neither relocation nor instability should erase the other.
The consumed path is dominated by a sustained one-sided decline with limited adverse excursion; broadness is parsimoniously explained by the repricing leg rather than independent disorder.
An initial opposite-side excursion and later sustained decline create both a coherent net repricing and independent broad reversal evidence.
A strong downward relocation remains visible, but large intermediate jumps and rebound structure provide separate instability evidence.
The path completes a material decline while also overshooting and reversing materially inside the window; both atomic propositions are defensible.
A coherent lower repricing coexists with a material late rebound and broad two-sided structure rather than a clean relocation-only path.

Most of the window-level change is a completed downward repricing followed by a lower-level hold; the shape matches the existing one-step-or-leg-then-flat relocation semantics more closely than independent instability.
A large net advance is coherent enough to retain relocation while repeated substantial pullbacks and re-expansion retain independent instability.
The decline is directionally meaningful, but the deep overshoot and strong rebound make structural disorder independently positive.
The path contains a real downward repricing plus a large opposite-side excursion before and during the leg; mixed directional instability is the bounded interpretation.
A material upward relocation coexists with repeated large reversals; forcing a single Stage0-versus-relocation answer discards atomic information.

claim_ceiling: Same-origin post-closeout semantic adjudication over consumed evidence. These classifications guide successor design but are not replacement labels and do not rewrite the sealed P011 review ledger.
